caption: (S1) In a bright home kitchen, a chef looks straight at the camera and says <d>[English] Fold the eggs gently and taste before you salt.</d> A pot simmers behind her with soft bubbling and no music.
Close-up of a vinyl record spinning on a turntable in a dim listening room; warm analog jazz with double bass and brushed drums fills the room while the camera slowly orbits the platter.
Heavy rain hammers a tin roof over a porch swing; each droplet burst is crisp and close while thunder rolls in the distance and the wooden swing creaks in stereo.
A kite surfer carves hard across choppy bay water while the camera dives alongside; spray hisses off the board edge, the sail flaps and snaps in the wind, and gulls cry overhead.
Two-shot scene: (shot 1) commuter train doors slide open with a pneumatic hiss and a station chime; (shot 2) cut to a diner interior where a waitress calls out an order while a grill sizzles.
